purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign039 mechanism against the complete terminal and prospective frontier before freezing a candidate formula or reading any candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_return_time_reversal_asymmetry_236p
selected_mechanism.formula: For each 120-close half independently, form 119 adjacent log returns. For each of the 118 ordered adjacent-return pairs (a,b) in that half, accumulate the antisymmetric cubic contrast a^2*b-a*b^2. Pool both halves into T=sum(a^2*b-a*b^2) and Q=sum(abs(a*b)*(abs(a)+abs(b))) across exactly 236 pairs. Return abs(T)/Q.
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A larger normalized magnitude of the antisymmetric adjacent-return third moment indicates stronger intraday time irreversibility and a more ordered shock-and-relaxation or information-assimilation process, which may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 raw unadjusted one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 after frozen timestamp normalization; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.half_session_rule: Treat the morning and afternoon as two independent fixed 120-position close paths. Form exactly 119 returns and 118 ordered adjacent-return pairs per half. Never create a lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition.
selected_mechanism.return_rule: Use signed natural-log adjacent close returns. Retain every exact-zero return in its fixed position and do not bridge, drop, rank, demean, standardize, clip, winsorize, or volatility-scale the return vectors.
selected_mechanism.antisymmetric_contrast_rule: For every ordered pair (a,b), use exactly a^2*b-a*b^2=a*b*(a-b). Reversing the pair changes the sign of this local contrast. Sum signed contrasts across both halves before taking one absolute value.
selected_mechanism.normalization_rule: Use Q=sum(abs(a*b)*(abs(a)+abs(b))) over the same 236 pairs. This equals the sum of the absolute magnitudes of the two cubic terms and guarantees abs(T)/Q in [0,1] for valid nonzero Q.
selected_mechanism.absolute_value_rule: Take one absolute value only after pooling every signed contrast across both halves. Never take pairwise absolute contrasts, separate-half absolute values, a signed final statistic, or a selected-half statistic.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid, nonpositive, or nonfinite selected close; any nonfinite log return, cubic contrast, normalization component, T, or Q; Q equal to zero; nonfinite asymmetry; or asymmetry outside [0,1] before a 1e-12 endpoint canonicalization makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: Those terminal factors summarize the unordered marginal sign or third-moment composition of returns. Campaign039 depends on ordered adjacent pairs and an antisymmetric cubic contrast that changes sign under pair reversal; it is not a marginal skewness, semivariance, or tail statistic.

Those factors use magnitude correlation, bipower-to-realized variation, or multi-minute variance aggregation. Campaign039 uses neither covariance nor variance ratios and retains the ordered signed cubic interaction of consecutive returns.

Sign-run and weak-order factors discard or discretize return magnitude into counts or states. Campaign039 uses the exact signed return magnitudes on fixed adjacent-pair support and contains no sign or ordinal classification.

Spectral entropy describes normalized power across frequencies after within-half demeaning. Campaign039 has no DFT, demeaning, frequency bin, entropy, taper, or phase statistic and measures a local third-order time-domain asymmetry.

Those factors summarize price-level geometry, endpoint displacement, extrema, or OHLC ranges. Campaign039 uses no price-level chord, endpoint displacement, high, low, extremum, range, or frontier; only adjacent signed close returns enter.

Campaign027 correlates ordinal-matched return positions across halves. Campaign039 never aligns morning with afternoon positions; it forms local pairs inside each half and pools their signed cubic contrasts before one absolute value.

Candidate49 counts close crossings around a causal cumulative amount/volume VWAP and is future-only. Campaign039 reads no amount or volume, constructs no anchor crossing, and remains historical-research-only.
Campaign039 contains no activity field, transaction price, peer benchmark, disclosure field, or event timing.
Campaign039 contains one exact raw-close statistic and no terminal factor value, transform, filter, fitted model, or combination.

decision.next_action: Validate the overlap-audit bindings, then freeze a fingerprint-bound no-return protocol with exactly this formula and the complete ordered 60-factor comparison library before implementing or opening any candidate value.
